newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Egged to cancel bus line to Cairo.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Egged to cancel bus line to Cairo.

text.p: Israel's main bus company, the Egged Transportation Cooperative, will cancel its weekly bus line to Cairo in six months, a spokesman said on Sunday.

The line from Jerusalem and Tel Aviv to Cairo has been operating for 15 years but in the past two years has been losing money. "During the past two years the bus has been travelling nearly empty with just 10 passengers a week," the spokesman told Israel Radio.
Egypt was the first Arab country to sign a peace accord with Israel in 1979. But ties between the two countries have recently been strained over the pace of the Middle East peace process.
The Egged spokesman said the company could not afford to keep up the unprofitable line.
The spokesman said he believes the government would hold a tender to find a new operator for the line, which also has political importance.
Officials at the Ministry of Transport could not be reached for comment.
